schema_version: 1
status: implemented
produced_stream: TEACHER_EVENTS
subjects_produced:
  - name: teacher.decision.recorded
    schema_version: 2
    owner: ms-go-teacher-agent
    payload: TeacherDecision
    v2_additions: [pedagogy_method, pedagogy_method_version, pedagogy_stage]
  - name: teacher.assistance.observed
    schema_version: 1
    owner: ms-go-teacher-agent
    payload: LearningActionAssistanceEventData
    granularity: one immutable summary per learning_action_id
    excludes: [success, failure, score, confidence, mastery]
subjects_consumed:
  - name: learning_action.closed
    stream: TASKANSWER_EVENTS
    schema_version: 1
    owner: ms-go-student
    durable: ms-teacher-learning-action-closed-v1
    queue: ms-teacher-learning-action-closed
    payload: action/context identity plus zero-to-100 frozen ordered learning targets
    excludes: [success, failure, score, confidence, mastery]
  - name: dialog.teacher.requested
    stream: DIALOG_EVENTS
    schema_versions: [1, 2]
    current_schema_version: 2
    owner: ms-go-dialog
    durable: ms-teacher-dialog-requested-v1
    queue: ms-teacher-dialog-requested
    runtime_status: composed; action contexts execute through the durable TeacherOrchestrator worker
    payload: source/dialog/student/PersonalTeacher identities, source channel, educational context, optional learning_action_id, and v2 dense-turn correlation evidence
    excludes: [message body, mastery, dialog history]
  - name: learning.activity.interesting
    stream: LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS
    schema_version: 1
    owner: ms-go-statistic
    durable: ms-teacher-learning-activity-v1
    queue: ms-teacher-learning-activity
    payload: bounded activity counters and opaque course, lesson, task, analytics-session references
    excludes: [student code, compiler output, raw error, mastery, dialog history]
  - name: course.plan.completed|course.plan.failed
    stream: LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS
    schema_version: 1
    owner: ms-go-learning-planner
    durable: ms-teacher-course-plan-outcome-v1
    queue: ms-teacher-course-plan-outcome
    payload: terminal planning result plus source, reason, and bounded Teacher audit references
    excludes: [generated curriculum, mastery, prompts, provider errors, chain-of-thought]
delivery:
  producer: PostgreSQL transactional outbox
  consumer: idempotent inbox or processed-event ledger
  consistency: at-least-once publication; consumers deduplicate by event_id
envelopes:
  teacher_turn_s0:
    schema: teacher-turn-s0.v1
    correlation_fields: [source_event_id, teacher_turn_sequence, dialog_id, canonical_student_message_id, source_message_sequence, student_id, personal_teacher_id, correlation_id, causation_id]
    optional: [teacher_job_id, action_receipt_id, student_command_id, ai_execution_id, learning_action_id]
    source_event_id: equals dialog.teacher.requested.event_id and is stable across retries
    correlation_semantics: correlation_id_is_uuid; dialog_event_causation_id_is_preserved_as_dialog_causation_id_and_equals_canonical_student_message_id_for_v2_text_turns; teacher_job_causation_id_is_derived_from_source_event_id_at_intake; action_turn_uses_action_receipt_id; text_turn_uses_canonical_student_message_id
    causation_scope: teacher_job_intake_only; AI_Prompt_Student_and_Dialog_response_boundaries_define_their_own_causation_ids
    teacher_turn_sequence: dense per-dialog expected ordering; turn N+1 is ineligible until N is safe
    source_message_sequence: evidence only; never an eligibility cursor
    cursor_advance: delivered (confirmed teacher_response_message_id) or proven failed_no_effect (no_effect_proof_id + recoverable_outcome_id + failure_code; attempted student_command_id may be present; no committed effect)
    reconciliation_blocking_states: unknown|partial|committed_unreconciled
    action_receipt_evidence: canonical-student-turn-interaction.v1/teacher_action_receipt; source prompt ID/version; block/action ASCII <=128; lowercase SHA-256 source_ui_digest
    boundary_chain: prompt -> receipt -> canonical_student_message_id -> source_event_id -> teacher_job_id -> teacher_response_message_id
    observability: IDs in structured logs only; metrics use low-cardinality categories and no ID labels; no subsystem in S0
    llm: AI Prompt boundary only; no Student mutation authority
    runtime: v1 and v2 are dual-read; v2 requires positive teacher_turn_sequence and all shared Teacher-job correlation fields; v2 is stored but not claimable while dense ordering is disabled
  teacher_events_and_learning_action_closed:
    required: [event_id, event_type, correlation_id, causation_id, student_id, occurred_at, schema_version, data]
  dialog_teacher_requested:
    required: [schema_version, event_id, occurred_at, dialog_id, event_sequence, source_message_id, source_message_sequence, channel, student_id, personal_teacher_id, context_type]
    optional: [context_id, learning_action_id]
    schema_versions: [1, 2]
    v2_required: [teacher_turn_sequence, canonical_student_message_id, correlation_id, causation_id]
    v2_optional: [action_receipt_id, source_message_version, reply_to_message_id]
    v2_forbidden: [student_command_id]
    v2_constraints: teacher_turn_sequence_positive; envelope_causation_id_is_dialog_event_causation_and_is_preserved; dialog_event_causation_id_matches_canonical_student_message_id; teacher_job_causation_id_is_derived_from_event_id; correlation_matches_canonical_message_or_action_receipt
  learning_activity_interesting:
    required: [schema_version, event_id, event_type, correlation_id, student_id, occurred_at, data]
    correlation: correlation_id equals analytics_session_id
retention:
  scope: TEACHER_EVENTS
  max_age_days: 7
  duplicate_window_minutes: 10
student_consumer:
  service: ms-go-student
  acknowledgement: after inbox and curated evidence commit
  mastery_update: forbidden from teacher facts alone
teacher_consumer:
  service: ms-go-teacher-agent
  acknowledgement: after inbox plus optional assistance/outbox commit
  poison_message: terminate invalid envelope, unknown field, subject, version, identity, context, or target
  transient_failure: negative acknowledgement with delay
  targetless: inbox-only; no teacher event
dialog_consumer:
  service: ms-go-teacher-agent
  acknowledgement_target: after teacher_dialog_job accepts the request or confirms an identical duplicate
  poison_message: terminate invalid JSON, unknown field, unsupported version, identity, or context shape
  conflicting_identity: terminate when an event or source-message identity is reused with different request metadata
  transient_failure: negative acknowledgement with delay
  context_read: exact source plus at most 49 prior messages through the internal Dialog API
  supported_contexts: general, selected-text lesson, lesson_task, practice_task, and project are processed asynchronously after acknowledgement
  lesson_verification: source carries current content_revision plus selected_text; Teacher requires exact Course revision and substring and sends only the fragment to the model
  deferred_contexts: whole-lesson tutoring without a selected fragment remains unsupported
  delivery: generated body is retained only while idempotent Dialog append is pending and cleared after verified delivery
  channel_delivery: web uses normal Dialog realtime; Telegram additionally enqueues one delivery by source_message_id after Dialog append
  mastery_consistency: response delivery does not wait for assistance evidence consumption or mastery recalculation
learning_activity_consumer:
  service: ms-go-teacher-agent
  acknowledgement_target: after intervention inbox/decision/outbox commit and any required idempotent Dialog delivery
  policy: replaceable deterministic policy selected by PersonalTeacher intervention_mode
  poison_message: terminate invalid JSON, unknown field, unsupported version, identity drift, or out-of-bounds aggregate
  transient_failure: negative acknowledgement with delay
  delivery: at most one proactive offer per student and analytics session through the general PersonalTeacher Dialog
  progress_rule: progressing observations stay silent
course_plan_outcome_consumer:
  service: ms-go-teacher-agent
  acknowledgement_target: Teacher-source outcome accepted into an idempotent inbox and any required Dialog append completed; other sources are acknowledged without state
  poison_message: terminate invalid JSON, unknown field, unsupported subject/version/status, identity drift, or invalid audit references
  transient_failure: negative acknowledgement with delay
  delivery: bounded localized business notification using event_id as Dialog idempotency key
planner_onboarding_path_outcome_consumer:
  service: ms-go-teacher-agent
  subject: planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1
  stream: LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS
  durable: ms-teacher-planner-onboarding-path-outcome-v1
  acknowledgement_target: exact S8 handoff-correlated outcome inbox plus idempotent localized personal-teacher Dialog append
  poison_message: terminate invalid JSON, unknown field, unsupported subject/version/status, status-specific ID violation, or identity drift
  transient_failure: negative acknowledgement with delay
  delivery: event_id is the Dialog idempotency key; PATH_READY carries bounded course/path/first-lesson IDs and conflict statuses carry none
correlation:
  learning_action_closed: correlation_id equals learning_action_id; causation_id equals answer_id
  teacher_assistance_observed: correlation_id equals learning_action_id; causation_id equals closure event_id
retry:
  strategy: exponential
  minimum_seconds: 1
  maximum_seconds: 300
  terminal_dead_letter: false
